title: middendorfia borysthenica
intro: Middendorfia borysthenica, commonly known as Middendorf's spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Middendorfia borysthenica include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to relieve coughs and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
